propositions: Pandoc subprocess can hang indefinitely on pathological input (13.5min observed) because pypandoc sets no timeout and subprocess.run(timeout=) reaps only direct child, not grandchild processes.
Process group must be reaped via rebar._proc.reap_process_group on subprocess.TimeoutExpired to kill CPU-spinning grandchildren that survive direct-child reaping.

DC renderer must use own subprocess.Popen(start_new_session=True) with caller-side communicate(input=markdown, timeout=dc_pandoc_timeout_s) instead of pypandoc high-level API to enable proper timeout and reaping.

Timeout value is configurable as reconciler.dc_pandoc_timeout_s with default 10s (above ~0.3s render time, below 13.5min hang), with schema, validator, environment binding, and config surface coverage.
On timeout or non-zero pandoc exit, affected unit degrades to original Markdown verbatim (per-unit fallback), leaving rendered output byte-identical to landed renderer and unaffecting other units.
Pandoc binary from pypandoc-binary wheel must be pinned in pyproject.toml and verified in CI, with GPL licence entry recorded in new repo-root NOTICE file for compliance.
